name: create an S3 bucket under a local emulated endpoint
definition: Use the AWS CLI pointing at the local object-store endpoint with its test credentials/region to create a bucket with the exact required name.
failure_mode: Creating with the wrong region/endpoint or name means it's not listed.

name: emulate a neuron with channel biophysics that reproduces a reference response
definition: Author the ion-channel gating classes and apply their biophysics across the loaded morphology.
failure_mode: channels not inserted or bound to the wrong sections fail to reproduce the reference response
